name: Spanish Teacher AI
description: Teaches Spanish to the world with a native cloned voice. Pronunciation lab (rr/ñ/j/ll), grammar path (ser/estar, por/para, subjunctive), verb conjugation, false friends, vocabulary SRS, register-aware conversation and C1/C2 writing feedback. Includes pre-generated native cloned-voice example phrases via a local Voicebox instance (instant playback, privacy-preserving).

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Daily dashboard: learner level, CEFR goal, streak and stats.

tools.name: get_pronunciation
tools.description: Sound guides for the tricky Spanish phonemes (rr, ñ, j, the 5 pure vowels, seseo, tildes).

tools.name: get_grammar_path
tools.description: Graded grammar path (ser/estar, por/para, past tenses, subjunctive, gender).

tools.name: get_conjugation
tools.description: Verb conjugation tables for regular and irregular Spanish verbs.

tools.name: get_vocabulary
tools.description: Vocabulary items with meaning glosses (es primary).

tools.name: submit_srs_review
tools.description: Record an SRS grade and reschedule the next review.

tools.name: send_conversation_message
tools.description: Register-aware conversation turn that corrects and upgrades the learner's Spanish.

tools.name: get_writing_feedback
tools.description: C1/C2 feedback on a written text (register-aware).

tools.name: get_voice_examples
tools.description: List pre-generated native cloned-voice example phrases (served instantly as cached WAV).

policy.voice_engine: browser Web Speech (default) + optional local Voicebox for cloned native examples
policy.voice_privacy: Voicebox runs on 127.0.0.1; cloned voice data never leaves the machine
